caption: The drawing consists of two simple, monochromatic black line illustrations on a plain, off-white background. Both illustrations are of a bonnet-style hat, shown from two different perspectives. The upper illustration shows the hat from the side, featuring a rounded crown, a wide brim, and a gathered or ruffled decorative element on top, likely made of fabric or flowers, with two short ribbons or ties hanging down. The lower illustration shows the hat from above, detailing the rounded shape, a large bow or ribbon at the back, and what appears to be a cluster of flowers or decorative trimming around the crown, as well as two longer ribbons extending downward from either side of the back. There are no colors other than the black lines and the natural background.
title: Hat
